description.html: HabiStat Tortoise Food Meadow Mix is a high-fiber, low-protein, calcium-rich pellet food for tortoises. Composition: oats, maize, lucerne, beet pulp, calcium carbonate, dicalcium phosphate and spirulina, with freshly mown grass aroma. Vitamins A, D3 and E are added, along with iron, copper, zinc, manganese, iodine and selenium. The grass aroma resembles the meadow plants tortoises eat in the wild, and it combines well with dandelion, plantain and other fresh greens.

This is a complementary food, not a replacement for fresh greens. The manufacturer recommends feeding it a couple of times a week as part of a varied diet, at 1-4% of the tortoise's body weight. Soak the pellets in warm water before feeding to soften them. Store in a cool, dark place.
It suits European, Russian and most other tortoise species. Learn how to set up a home for your tortoise in our tortoise terrarium guide.
To order, contact us by phone or WhatsApp. We deliver to all towns in Serbia. In-person pickup is available in Novi Sad.
